description: This file defines a Kotlin object StringUtils with utility functions for string manipulation, specifically join and split operations utilizing external utility classes.

classes.name: StringUtils
classes.description: A singleton object providing string utility functions for joining a LinkedList into a String and splitting a String into a LinkedList.

methods.name: join
methods.description: Converts a LinkedList to a String using JoinUtils.

methods.name: split
methods.description: Converts a String into a LinkedList using SplitUtils.
